gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Giraffe's own Grandfalls manuals tell owners to take the washer down and store it indoors for the winter, that the pump "is susceptible to permanent damage if it freezes" below 32°F (0°C), and that "FREEZE DAMAGE IS NOT COVERED BY THE WARRANTY". For an all-in-one unit sold to hang permanently in a garage, that means it can't stay up year-round in a garage that freezes.
standout_why: I opened Bob Vila's Grandfalls Pro review (cited), fixlinelocal's guide and Giraffe's own '5 Best Wall-Mounted' blog (cited). None mentions freezing, winter storage, pump antifreeze or the warranty exclusion. Bob Vila tested in Florida, and fixlinelocal only says the unit 'stays on the garage or house wall'. Our current page has part of it ('Unheated garages that freeze, unless you will drain the pump every fall'), but it understates the maker's instructions. The manual says to dismantle the unit and store it indoors, and to run a pump saver or non-toxic antifreeze through it, not just drain it. Our page also doesn't cite the warranty exclusion. The rating is 3 for the shopper's literal 'garage' setup in any climate that freezes. In a heated garage or a warm climate it falls to 2.
decides: If the garage drops below 32°F, the all-in-one Grandfalls units (Pro, Lite Pro, Plus, G20) stop being 'mount it and forget it'. Giraffe's manuals say to dismantle the unit and store it indoors each winter, and freeze damage is excluded from warranty. A cold garage favours the modular route that ChatGPT's second chat floated: a standalone washer you carry inside for winter, plus a reel that stays on the wall (our page lists Giraffe's 1/4 in pressure reel as rated -40 to 150 °F). In a heated garage or warm climate, the Grandfalls picks stand.

findings.value: "The pump in this machine is susceptible to permanent damage if it freezes." and "FREEZE DAMAGE IS NOT COVERED BY THE WARRANTY."

findings.label: Maker's winter instruction
findings.value: "please dismantle the pressure washer … and store it indoors during winter"; "Operate the pressure washer with a non-corrosive/non-toxic anti-freeze, a pump saver, or a pump protector before storing it for the winter." Also: "Always empty water from all hoses, and the pump before storing."
findings.source_title: Giraffe Tools Grandfalls G30A manual, p.19 (ManualsLib)
findings.note: This conflicts with a Google snippet of a Giraffe blog post that advises against antifreeze. I could not open that blog (it rendered empty), so I rely on the manual's wording.
